Variables: senior accountants, junior accountants
Constraints:
(-1.0) * senior accountants + (-1.0) * junior accountants <= -100.0
(-1.0) * senior accountants + (-0.0) * junior accountants <= -5.0
(-1.0) * senior accountants + (0.3333333333333333) * junior accountants <= -0.0
(3000.0) * senior accountants + (1000.0) * junior accountants <= 150000.0
Objective Function:
minimize (3000.0) * senior accountants + (1000.0) * junior accountants
